text:
marie (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for the Optimize toolkit PRD. Customers (Acme, Nova) are asking for concrete launch guidance for batching, caching, and quant profiles. Two main asks: 1) launch criteria (latency/cost/quality targets) and 2) recommended default configs for hosted vs dedicated. Can we sketch tradeoffs?

devin (eng-ml): Short: batching raises throughput but can increase tail latency. For long-context workloads (>=8k) batching = big win. For short requests (<1k tokens) batching often hurts p50. We should expose a "latency vs cost" profile.

sasha (eng-platform): Note: Dedicated pools can't share a global prefix cache today. Per-tenant cache is doable but needs storage + eviction + metrics. Cold-cache p99 spikes will affect SLA if we don't set conservative defaults.

jordan (solutions): Customers want an "easy mode" knob: latency-priority | balanced | cost-priority. Map those to batch_size, max_wait_ms, and quant_profile. Also provide sample configs + migration notes.

marie (PM): Draft acceptance criteria below — please comment inline.
```
- Functional: Toolkit provides three named profiles (latency, balanced, cost) with documented default values.
- Performance: Balanced profile <= 1.5x hosted baseline cost, p50 < 150ms for short requests (<=512 tokens), p95 < 450ms for mixed workloads.
- Quality: Quantized profiles (4-bit/8-bit) must have <= 1.0% relative drop on Golden eval set per model.
- Operational: Telemetry for batch sizes, cache hit rate, and quant usage; alerts for cache-thrashing and elevated p99.
- Docs: Migration guide + example config snippets for Hosted, Dedicated, Private deploys.
```

devin (eng-ml): Couple of clarifications: the p50/p95 numbers above assume model family X-like (decoder-only). We should specify per-model baselines in PRD. Also quality: 4-bit often OK but needs per-model eval. Suggest we require a per-model regression test pipeline.

sasha (eng-platform): I'll add cost impact brackets for per-tenant cache storage. Rough ballpark: per-tenant cache adds ~5-10% infra cost at scale unless we limit TTL / shard size. Need a flag to disable caching for small tenants.

jordan (solutions): Edge cases from customers: streaming chat that expects sub-100ms first-token latency; long-document summarization where batching matters; single-tenant enterprise with strict data residency that wants Private + no shared cache. We should call these out.

marie (PM): Agreed. Next steps: Devin, please add a short section on "auto-tune heuristics" (how we pick batch_size/max_wait) with loss/latency tradeoff experiments. Sasha, add platform constraints and rollout plan. Jordan, add customer examples + recommended sample configs. I'll assemble into a PRD draft.

devin (eng-ml): For auto-tune: propose a background probe that runs at low QPS to estimate latency distribution for sequences of different lengths, then choose max_wait_ms per model/class. Will write up simple algo + pseudo-code.

sasha (eng-platform): For rollout: gated canary by customer tier + model. We should default caching off for first 2 weeks of launch to avoid surprises, or enable with conservative TTL.

jordan (solutions): I can produce 3 ready-to-send customer playbooks for the three profiles. Also start an FAQ for known regressions with quantized models.

ops-bot: Reminder: add link to RFC draft and PRD stub: https://go/redwood/rfc/opt-toolkit-bcq (please attach in the PRD).

marie (PM): Thanks. Proposed timeline: PRD draft by EOD Thursday, internal crit review Friday, decision sync next Tue. Can folks commit? @devin @sasha @jordan

devin (eng-ml): I can get my section done by Thu EOD.

sasha (eng-platform): Yep, will add platform notes by Thu.

jordan (solutions): I'll have playbooks + examples by Thu as well.

marie (PM): Ok scheduling: quick decision call Thu 09:00 PT listed as optional for execs, mandatory for eng + product + solutions. I'll post invite. Also add a short checklist in the PRD:
- Per-model baseline numbers included
- Eval set and regression thresholds attached
- Rollout plan + feature flagging steps

devin (eng-ml): Quick technical note: quant profiles should be versioned (q1, q2) so we can rollback per-model. Also add per-profile golden eval artifact links.

sasha (eng-platform): Request: platform needs rough capacity estimate to size dedicated pools for canary + steady state. I'll ping infra for numbers once PRD has expected qps distributions.

marie (PM): Great. I'll create PRD draft and drop link here when ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:

ops-bot: marie (PM) created draft PRD: https://go/redwood/doc/prd/optimize-toolkit-draft (editable)

marie (PM): Added meeting invite and a short doc skeleton. Leave comments on doc or ping in thread if anything urgent.

jordan (solutions): 👍 adding customer examples now.

devin (eng-ml): I'll upload initial benchmark table to doc by EOD.

sasha (eng-platform): I'll add cost estimates and the conservative rollout checklist.

marie (PM): Perfect — catching up on this Thu. Thanks everyone.
